pages.text:
LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT
of ARTHUR PENDELTON
I, ARTHUR PENDELTON, a resident of Austin, Travis County, State of Texas, being of sound 
mind and disposing memory, and not acting under duress, menace, fraud, or undue influence of 
any person whomsoever, do hereby make, publish, and declare this instrument to be my Last 
Will and Testament, hereby revoking all prior wills and codicils heretofore made by me.
Article I: IDENTIFICATION OF FAMILY
Section 1.01 Marital Status. I am married to Eleanor Vance Pendelton, and all references in 
this Will to "my spouse" are to said person.
Section 1.02 Children. I have two (2) living children, namely:
• Chloe Pendelton, born April 10, 2008
• Liam Pendelton, born November 15, 2011
All references in this Will to "my children" include the above-named children and any child 
hereafter born to or legally adopted by me.
Article II: PAYMENT OF DEBTS, EXPENSES, AND TAXES
Section 2.01 Debts and Expenses. I direct my Executor to pay out of my residuary estate all of 
my legally enforceable unsecured debts, funeral expenses, expenses of my last illness, and the 
expenses of administering my estate as soon after my demise as is practicable. Secured debts 
encumbering specific property (such as a residential mortgage or automobile loan) shall pass 
with the respective property unless otherwise specified herein.
Section 2.02 Estate and Inheritance Taxes. All federal, state, and local estate, inheritance, or 
succession taxes (including any interest and penalties thereon) payable by reason of my death 
with respect to property passing under this Will shall be paid out of my residuary estate without 
apportionment among the recipients thereof.
Article III: DISPOSITION OF TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY & SPECIFIC 
BEQUESTS
Section 3.01 Tangible Personal Property. I give and bequeath all of my clothing, jewelry, 
household furniture and furnishings, personal automobiles, personal effects, and other tangible 
personal property not otherwise specifically disposed of herein to my spouse, Eleanor Vance 
Pendelton, if she survives me by thirty (30) days; otherwise to my children who survive me by 
thirty (30) days, in shares of substantially equal value as they shall agree.
Section 3.02 Specific Bequests. I make the following specific gifts of cash or personal 
property:
(a) I give Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000) to the Austin Public Library Foundation, Austin, TX, if 
it is in existence at my death; if not, this gift shall lapse and become part of my residuary estate.

Section 3.03 Written Memorandum. I may leave a separate written statement or list disposing 
of certain items of my tangible personal property. Any such list in existence at the time of my 
death, signed and dated by me, shall be determinative with respect to the items devised therein.
Article IV: DISPOSITION OF RESIDUARY ESTATE
Section 4.01 Primary Residuary Beneficiary. I give, devise, and bequeath all the rest, 
residue, and remainder of my estate, of every kind and character and wheresoever situated, 
including any lapsed or failed devises (my "Residuary Estate"), to my spouse, Eleanor Vance 
Pendelton, provided she survives me by thirty (30) days.
Section 4.02 Contingent Residuary Beneficiaries. If Eleanor Vance Pendelton does not 
survive me by thirty (30) days, I give, devise, and bequeath my Residuary Estate to my 
descendants who survive me, per stirpes. If neither my primary beneficiary nor any of my 
descendants survive me, I give my Residuary Estate to my brother, Graham M. Pendelton.
Article V: APPOINTMENT OF EXECUTOR (PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE)
Section 5.01 Nomination of Executor. I nominate and appoint Eleanor Vance Pendelton, of 
Austin, Texas, as Independent Executor of this my Last Will and Testament. If Eleanor Vance 
Pendelton is unable or unwilling to serve, I nominate and appoint Graham M. Pendelton, of 
Atlanta, Georgia, as Alternate Independent Executor.
Section 5.02 Bond and Independent Administration. No bond or other security shall be 
required of any Executor named herein in any jurisdiction. To the fullest extent permitted by the 
laws of the State of Texas, I direct that no action shall be had in any court in the administration 
of my estate other than the probating and recording of this Will and the return of an inventory, 
appraisement, and list of claims of my estate (or an affidavit in lieu thereof).
Section 5.03 Executor Powers. My Executor shall have all powers conferred upon fiduciaries 
by state law, including the power to sell, lease, mortgage, or liquidate any real or personal 
property of my estate at public or private sale, with or without notice, distribute assets in cash or 
in kind, settle claims, and employ legal, accounting, or investment professionals.
Article VI: CUSTODIAL PROVISIONS FOR MINOR OR YOUNG 
BENEFICIARIES
Section 6.01 Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA). If any beneficiary entitled to receive a 
distribution under this Will is under the age of twenty-one (21) years at the time of distribution, 
my Executor may distribute such share to a custodian selected by my Executor for such 
beneficiary under the Texas Uniform Transfers to Minors Act.
Article VII: GENERAL & MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS
Section 7.01 Survivorship Requirement. For all purposes of this Will, no person shall be 
deemed to have survived me unless such person is living on the thirtieth (30th) day following the 
date of my death.

Section 7.02 Severability. If any provision of this Will is held invalid, unenforceable, or void, the 
remaining provisions shall nevertheless continue in full force and effect.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I, ARTHUR PENDELTON, have hereunto subscribed my name to 
this Last Will and Testament, consisting of this and the preceding pages, on this ______ day of 
________________________, 20____, at Austin, Texas.
__________________________________________________
ARTHUR PENDELTON, Testator
ATTESTATION CLAUSE: DECLARATION OF WITNESSES
On the date written above, ARTHUR PENDELTON declared to us, the undersigned, that the 
foregoing instrument was his Last Will and Testament, and requested us to act as witnesses to 
the same. The Testator thereupon signed this Will in our presence, all of us being present at the 
same time. We now, at the Testator's request, in the Testator's presence, and in the presence 
of each other, subscribe our names as witnesses, believing the Testator to be of sound mind 
and over the age of eighteen (18) years, and acting voluntarily without duress or undue 
influence.
Witness 1 Signature: ____________________________________     Date: ______________
Name: Marcus Vance
Address: 1204 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701
Witness 2 Signature: ____________________________________     Date: ______________
Name: Sarah Jenkins
Address: 4501 Guadalupe St, Austin, TX 78751
SELF-PROVING AFFIDAVIT
STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF TRAVIS
Before me, the undersigned authority, on this day personally appeared ARTHUR PENDELTON, 
Marcus Vance, and Sarah Jenkins, known to me to be the Testator and the witnesses, 
respectively, whose names are subscribed to the annexed or foregoing instrument in their 
respective capacities, and, all of said persons being by me duly sworn, the said Testator 
declared to me and to the said witnesses in my presence that said instrument is his Last Will 
and Testament, and that he had willingly made and executed it as his free act and deed; and 
the said witnesses, each on their oath stated to me, in the presence and hearing of the said 
Testator, that the said Testator had declared to them that said instrument is his Last Will and 
Testament, and that he executed same as such and wanted each of them to sign it as a 
witness; and upon their oaths each witness stated further that they did sign the same as witness 
in the presence of the said Testator and at his request; that the Testator was at that time 
eighteen years of age or over and was of sound mind; and that each of said witnesses was then 
at least fourteen years of age.

ADVANCE HEALTHCARE DIRECTIVE
Medical Power of Attorney, Living Will & HIPAA Authorization
I, ARTHUR PENDELTON, Date of Birth: 05/14/1975, residing at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Austin, 
TX 78701, being of sound mind, willfully and voluntarily execute this Advance Healthcare 
Directive consisting of Part I (Medical Power of Attorney / Healthcare Proxy), Part II (Living Will / 
Directive to Physicians), and Part III (HIPAA Release & Organ Donation Preferences).
Part I: DESIGNATION OF HEALTHCARE PROXY (MEDICAL POWER OF 
ATTORNEY)
Section 1.01 Appointment of Primary Healthcare Agent: If I become unable to make my own 
health-care decisions, as determined by my attending physician, I appoint the following person 
as my Healthcare Agent to make any and all health-care decisions for me:
• Name: Eleanor Vance Pendelton
• Relationship: Spouse
• Address: 742 Evergreen Terrace, Austin, TX 78701
• Primary Phone: (512) 555-0143          Alternate Phone: (512) 555-0144
Section 1.02 Alternate Healthcare Agents: If my Primary Healthcare Agent is unwilling, 
unable, or unavailable to act, I appoint:
• First Alternate Agent: Graham M. Pendelton, Relationship: Brother, Phone: (404) 555-0199
• Second Alternate Agent: Clara Vance, Relationship: Sister-in-Law, Phone: (512) 555-0188
Section 1.03 Scope of Agent's Authority: My Healthcare Agent is authorized to consent to, 
refuse, or withdraw any medical treatment, surgical procedure, diagnostic test, medication, 
hospitalization, nursing home or hospice care, and life-sustaining treatment on my behalf, in 
accordance with my wishes stated in Part II below or, if my wishes are unknown, in accordance 
with my best interests.
Part II: LIVING WILL (DIRECTIVE TO PHYSICIANS & FAMILY)
If I am diagnosed and certified in writing by two qualified physicians to have an incurable or 
irreversible condition listed below, I direct my physicians and Healthcare Agent as follows:
Section 2.01 Terminal Condition Election: [ AP ] Choice 1 - Comfort Care Only: I direct that 
all treatments other than those needed to keep me comfortable and free of pain be discontinued 
or withheld, and my physician allow me to die as gently as possible.
Section 2.02 Irreversible Coma / Persistent Vegetative State Election: [ AP ] Choice 1 - 
Discontinue Life Support: I direct that all treatments other than those needed to keep me 
comfortable be discontinued or withheld.
Section 2.03 Artificial Nutrition and Hydration: [ AP ] I DO NOT want artificial nutrition and 
hydration (tube feeding/IV fluids) if it merely prolongs the dying process or an irreversible 
vegetative state.

Section 2.04 Pain Relief & Palliative Care: In all circumstances, I direct that I receive 
maximum palliative care and medication necessary to alleviate pain and discomfort, even if 
such medication may unintentionally hasten the moment of my death.
Part III: HIPAA RELEASE AUTHORIZATION & ANATOMICAL GIFTS
Section 3.01 Immediate HIPAA Release: Effective immediately, I authorize all health-care 
providers, hospitals, clinics, and insurers to disclose, release, and discuss all of my Protected 
Health Information (PHI) and medical records with my Primary and Alternate Healthcare Agents 
named in Part I above.
Section 3.02 Organ and Tissue Donation: [ AP ] I give any needed organs, tissues, or parts 
for transplantation, therapy, or medical research.

ARTHUR PENDELTON, Declarant/Principal
